descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

The Microbial Physiology and Resource Biorecovery Laboratory (MICROBE), led by Dr. Wenyu Gu at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne (EPFL), invites applications for a fully funded Postdoctoral Researcher position in Microbial Ecology.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented postdoctoral researcher to join our team at the Institute of Environmental Engineering. The successful candidate will conduct cutting-edge research in applied and environmental microbiology, with a particular focus on microbial community assembly and interaction principles using anaerobic digestion communities as a model system.

Main duties and responsibilities

Anaerobic digestion communities are among the best-characterized and most ecologically important microbial ecosystems. Composed of diverse bacteria and archaea that cooperate through metabolic interactions, these communities drive the degradation of organic matter in oxygen-free environments and ultimately produce methane. They play a central role in global carbon cycling and provide an excellent model for investigating fundamental questions in microbial ecology, including community assembly, species interactions, resilience, and ecosystem functioning.

Using enrichment cultures combined with metabolite profiling and multi-omics analyses, our group has recently revealed that: (1) environmental selection imposed by pH and substrate availability constrains metabolic network architecture despite substantial taxonomic turnover in anaerobic digestion communities, providing a mechanistic explanation for convergent ecosystem functions across similar environments; and (2) amino acid fermentation requires the balancing of oxidative and reductive half-reactions, with Stickland metabolism partitioned among community members rather than encoded and expressed within individual genomes. These findings demonstrate that redox balancing during amino acid fermentation is an emergent property of the microbial community, maintained through metabolite cross-feeding. (Both studies are currently under review.)

Building on these findings, the successful candidate will investigate how microbial interactions shape ecosystem functions and how interaction principles scale in complex communities. The project combines experimental and computational approaches, including high-throughput sequencing, bioinformatics, microbial isolation and cultivation, physiological characterization, and community-level activity and function analyses.

This position is funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) and EPFL. The postdoctoral researcher will collaborate closely with PhD students and fellow postdoctoral researchers within the laboratory and across EPFL’s international research network.

Profile

• PhD degree in environmental engineering, microbiology, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

• Strong publication record and demonstrated research accomplishments, including peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.

• Experience in bioinformatics and modeling is valuable.

• Strong communication and scientific writing skills in English.

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international research environment.

We offer

• Mentoring and support for professional and career development.

• A stimulating, multicultural research environment with access to state-of-the-art facilities.

• Opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and international networking.

• A world-class research and training environment within the ETH Domain.

Informations

• Start date: Flexible.

• Contract duration: One-year contract, renewable annually for up to three years.

To apply, please follow the instructions provided in the application portal linked below.

Please prepare the following application materials:

• Motivation letter.

• Detailed curriculum vitae (CV).

• Contact information.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

The Microbial Physiology and Resource Biorecovery Laboratory (MICROBE), led by Dr. Wenyu Gu at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne (EPFL), invites applications for a fully funded PhD position in Microbial Physiology.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented PhD student to join our team at the Institute of Environmental Engineering. The successful candidate will conduct cutting-edge research in applied and environmental microbiology, with a focus on the physiology and genetic regulation of methane-producing archaea: methanogens. These microorganisms play a central role in the global carbon cycle by mediating the terminal steps of organic matter degradation in anoxic environments. Their activity serves as a critical gatekeeper of energy flow in oxygen-depleted ecosystems, including wetlands, sediments, animal digestive tracts, and anaerobic digesters, where they catalyze the final stages of anaerobic carbon mineralization.

Main duties and responsibilities

The research will investigate how methanogens respond to dynamic environmental conditions and interact with other members of microbial communities, advancing our understanding of the ecological mechanisms governing methane production and informing future biotechnological applications. The project will combine a range of experimental and computational approaches, including high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics, microbial isolation and cultivation, physiological characterization of gas-utilizing microorganisms, and co-culture and community function analyses.

The PhD candidate will collaborate closely with other PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, both within the laboratory and across EPFL’s international research network.

Profile

• Master's degree in environmental engineering, microbiology, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated research experience through a master's thesis, publications, or equivalent research projects.

• Prior experience in wet-lab microbiology and/or bioinformatics is an advantage.

• Strong communication and scientific writing skills in English.

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international research environment.

We offer

• Mentoring and support for professional and personal development.

• A stimulating, multicultural research environment with access to state-of-the-art facilities.

• Opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and international networking.

• A world-class training environment within the ETH Domain.

Informations

• Start date: Flexible.

• Contract duration: One-year contract, renewable annually for up to four years.

To apply, please follow the instructions provided in the application portal linked below.

Please prepare the following application materials:

• Motivation letter.

• Detailed curriculum vitae (CV).

• Contact information.

• Names and contact details of three references who are willing to provide recommendation letters.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been identified and the position has been filled.

Contesto Il Vicepresidente delle Operazioni gestisce ogni giorno tutte le attività che fanno vivere i campus EPFL, tra cui restauro, sistemi informativi, sicurezza e funzionamento, e prevede lo sviluppo della sua infrastruttura. La sua gestione è alla ricerca del futuro direttore del settore dei sistemi informativi di EPFL. Missione Il Direttore dei Sistemi Informativi fornisce una leadership strategica dell'ecosistema digitale di EPFL e dell'infrastruttura IT centrale, in stretta collaborazione con la comunità accademica. Egli federazione risorse fondamentali per garantire la resilienza digitale dell'Istituto e l'eccellenza operativa. A capo della tenuta, supervisiona un team di 160 FTE e un budget annuale di 50 MCHF. Principali compiti e responsabilità Visione e governance federativa
• Co-definire una strategia digitale visionaria, ambiziosa e coerente per i servizi IT centrali ed EPFL
• Federate team, partner interni ed esterni, compresi i partner CEPF, per implementare questa strategia
• Agire come direttore a livello di Facoltà per armonizzare i SI decentrati nel rispetto della loro specifica agilità Gestione delle infrastrutture IT
• Pilotare il funzionamento, la manutenzione e l'evoluzione delle infrastrutture critiche (Datacenter, reti, storage, cloud ibrido) per garantire un'elevata disponibilità e prestazioni industriali
• Distribuire capacità di calcolo sovrano (HPC) e ambienti AI, fornendo agli utenti strumenti all'avanguardia sotto stretto controllo istituzionale Resistenza digitale
• Assicurare l'integrità del patrimonio scientifico e amministrativo attraverso un'esemplare politica di sicurezza informatica
• Assicurarsi che i SI siano mantenuti che soddisfino i requisiti e gli standard legali Partenariato accademico
• Agire come partner tecnologico per i laboratori fornendo servizi di gestione dei dati e infrastrutture agili, nel rispetto del quadro di strategia unica
• Modernizzare l'esperienza di insegnamento e apprendimento mantenendo aggiornato gli ERP accademici delle esigenze in rapida evoluzione e supportando le pedagogie digitali innovative Trasformazione responsabile
• Pilotare il percorso di sostenibilità digitale (Green IT) del dominio
• Garantire una gestione esemplare delle risorse umane e finanziarie in uno spirito di innovazione, performance ed equità Profilo Profilo di "Architetto-Bâtisseur" con una forte influenza di leadership:
• Master o PhD in informatica, ingegneria o equivalente; MBA o ulteriore formazione in business management/governance
• Min. 15 anni di esperienza professionale, tra cui almeno 10 anni in un grande ruolo di leadership SI (CIO/CTO) in organizzazioni complesse
• Esperienza dimostrata nei principali programmi digitali, con una forte direzione di cambiamento
• Capacità politica di riunire gli interessi decentralizzati e garantire una coerenza istituzionale globale
• Sintesi e ottime capacità di comunicazione
• Cultura del servizio orientata verso l'eccellenza accademica
• comprovata padronanza della sicurezza informatica, della governance dei dati e della continuità aziendale negli ambienti esposti
• Lingue: bilingue francese-inglese; tedesco un bene Offriamo

Background The Vice-President for Operations manages all activities that make EPFL campuses live on a daily basis, including restoration, information systems, security and operation, and plans the development of its infrastructure. Its management is looking for its future director of EPFL's information systems field. Mission The Director of Information Systems provides strategic leadership of EPFL's digital ecosystem and central IT infrastructure, in close collaboration with the academic community. He/she federates core resources to ensure the Institute's digital resilience and operational excellence. At the head of the estate, he/she oversees a team of 160 FTEs and an annual budget of MCHF 50. Main tasks and responsibilities Vision and federative governance
• Co-defining a visionary, ambitious and coherent digital strategy for EPFL and central IT services
• Federate teams, internal and external partners, including CEPF partners, to deploy this strategy
• Act as conductor at the Faculty level to harmonize decentralized SIs while respecting their specific agility Central IT infrastructure management
• Piloting the operation, maintenance and evolution of critical infrastructures (Datacenters, networks, storage, hybrid cloud) to ensure high availability and industrial performance
• Deploy sovereign computing capabilities (HPC) and AI environments, providing users with state-of-the-art tools under strict institutional control Digital resilience
• Ensuring the integrity of the scientific and administrative heritage through an exemplary cybersecurity policy
• Ensure that SIs are maintained that meet legal requirements and standards Academic partnership
• Act as a technology partner for laboratories by providing data management services and agile infrastructure, while respecting the single strategy framework
• Modernise teaching and learning experience by maintaining up-to-date academic ERPs of rapidly changing needs and supporting innovative digital pedagogies Responsible Transformation
• Piloting the digital sustainability path (Green IT) of the domain
• Ensuring exemplary management of human and financial resources in a spirit of innovation, performance and equity Profile Profile of "Architect-Bâtisseur" with a strong leadership influence:
• Master or PhD in computer science, engineering or equivalent; MBA or further training in business management/governance major asset
• Min. 15 years of professional experience, including at least 10 years in a large SI leadership role (CIO/CTO) in complex organisations
• Experience demonstrated in leading major digital programs, with strong change direction
• Political capacity to bring decentralized interests together while ensuring overall institutional coherence
• Synthesis and excellent communication skills
• Culture of service oriented towards academic excellence
• Proven mastery of cybersecurity, data governance and business continuity issues in exposed environments
• Languages: French-English bilingual; German an asset We offer
• A quality multicultural and academic working environment
• Opportunities for continuing training
• An involvement at the heart of EPFL's Information System Information Effective date: September 1, 2026 or to be agreed Occupancy rate: 100% Type of contract: CDI Reference: 2249 Deadline for application: 14 June 2026 Note: An extract of the criminal record will be requested when the offer is made

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. This position is based at Campus Biotech in Geneva, EPFL's associated campus. On the shores of Lake Geneva, Campus Biotech brings together EPFL, the University of Geneva, the Wyss Center, the Geneva University Hospitals (HUG), and startups in a uniquely interdisciplinary ecosystem.

The A. Mathis Group for Computational Neuroscience and AI, under the supervision of Professor Alexander Mathis, is seeking an Administrative Assistant to ensure the smooth and efficient day-to-day operations of the laboratory. You will collaborate closely with the professor, researchers, students, and EPFL central services to support the execution of projects and daily activities, playing a central part in enabling the lab's research and operational missions. You will report directly to the lab head.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Assistance with funds and grants management, including monitoring expenditures, financial reporting (salaries, invoices, credit card expenses), financial forecasts, purchases, and reports;

• Staff administration: support to the hiring process, preparation of employment contracts (academic and non-academic), accreditation, onboarding and offboarding, management of absences and agendas, and follow-up of the employee lifecycle (including interns, summer interns, and visiting researchers).

• Calendar and agenda management: management of the professor's calendar, scheduling and coordinating meetings and appointments, and general administrative support to the professor's activities.

• Event organization: coordination of trips, meetings, conferences, seminars, and symposiums; organization of thesis defenses, group meetings, and team-building activities.

• Visitor and mobility management: organization of arrivals for new employees and visiting researchers, assistance with visa applications, accommodation, and health insurance, and full travel management for guests.

• Coordination: liaising with EPFL central and academic services (Doctoral School, Sections, Dean's team, etc.), funding agencies, and external partners.

Your profile

• Proven experience as an administrative assistant, ideally in an academic or research environment.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Proactive, reliable, and service-oriented, with a "can-do" mindset.

• Fluency in French and English is required.

• Computer proficiency, with an excellent command of Outlook and a very good command of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Familiarity with project management tools is a plus.

• Ability to interact with all levels of faculty, staff, and students and to thrive in a multicultural environment.

We offer

• Excellent working conditions.

• A multicultural and stimulating environment.

• Opportunities for further education and professional development.

Informations

Activity Rate Max : 50.00

Duration:

La Cattedra di Modelli Numerici e Simulazione di EPFL è dedicata alla progettazione e analisi di algoritmi numerici per equazioni differenziali parziali. La nostra ricerca è orientata allo sviluppo di tecniche numeriche innovative e innovative che mirano a migliorare l'integrazione tra simulazioni numeriche e modellazione geometrica e lavorazione.

All'interno del progetto «FLASh: strumenti di simulazione rapidi per le strutture di LAttice» , finanziato dalla Fondazione Nazionale di Scienza Svizzera, stiamo aprendo una posizione post-dottorale per lo sviluppo di algoritmi efficienti per l'ottimizzazione della topologia dei materiali progettati utilizzando la tecnica degli elementi finiti

Come postdoc nel nostro gruppo, guiderai la ricerca sulla progettazione e l'implementazione di metodi matematici sonori per l'ottimizzazione della topologia dei materiali progettati, sfruttando tecniche di simulazione veloci come i metodi di elementi finiti non idonei, la decomposizione di dominio, la modellazione di ordine ridotta, o l'analisi isogeometrica. About us and our project

The Chair of Numerical Modelling and Simulation at EPFL is dedicated to the design and analysis of numerical algorithms for partial differential equations. Our research is oriented towards the development of novel and innovative numerical techniques aiming at improving the integration between numerical simulations and geometric modelling and processing.

Within the project «FLASh: Fast simulation tools for LAttice Structures» , funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation, we are opening a postdoctoral position for developing efficient algorithms for the topology optimization of architected materials using finite element technique

What you will do

As a postdoc in our group, you will lead research on the design and implementation of mathematically sound methods for the topology optimization of architected materials, leveraging fast simulation techniques such as unfitted finite element methods, domain decomposition, reduced order modeling, or isogeometric analysis. You will work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, contributing to both the theoretical development and the software implementation of these methods. More specifically:

• Lead and contribute to research projects in the broad areas of numerical simulation and topology optimization, within FLASh and related initiatives

• Develop, implement, and maintain in-house simulation and topology optimization software

• Analyze, interpret, and publish results in leading international journals

• Present your work at national and international conferences and build a strong network in the field

• Mentor and co-supervise PhD and Master students

• Contribute to teaching activities within the group

• Assist in the preparation of grant proposals and project reports

•

You are the ideal candidate if

• You hold a PhD (or are nearing completion of one) in mathematics, computational mechanics, engineering, or a related field

• You have a strong background in topology optimization, ideally with experience in density-based methods (SIMP), level set approaches, or related design-for-manufacturing frameworks

• You have research experience in numerical methods for PDEs: finite element methods, immersed/unfitted methods, homogenization, or isogeometric analysis are particularly relevant

• You are proficient in Python; prior experience with the FEniCS library is a plus; C++ knowledge is an additional asset

• You have strong computational skills, including the implementation of simulation and optimization pipelines; experience with HPC or large-scale scientific computing is a plus

• You have a publication record (relative to your career stage) in internationally leading journals in computational mechanics, applied mathematics, or related areas

• You are passionate about mathematics and scientific computing, and motivated by challenging problems

• You are independent, creative, and solution-oriented, with strong self-management skills and the ability to drive research forward with limited supervision

• You think critically and are eager to work at the interface of numerical simulation and structural design for lattice/metamaterial architectures

• You communicate excellently in written and oral English

• You are a team player, open to interdisciplinary collaboration

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment located in beautiful Switzerland

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions. More information can be found on our website

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

• Friendly and supportive team culture

• A 1+1 years contract

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

• A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

descriptionByLocale.fr: A propos de nous et de notre projet La Chaire de modélisation et de simulation numériques de l'EPFL est dédiée à la conception et à l'analyse d'algorithmes numériques pour les équations différentielles partielles. Dans le cadre du projet «FLASH: Fast simulation tools for LAttice Structures», financé par la Fondation nationale suisse des sciences, nous ouvrons une position postdoctorale pour le développement d'algorithmes efficaces pour l'optimisation topologique des matériaux d'architecture en utilisant la technique des éléments finis Ce que vous ferez En tant que postdoc dans notre groupe, vous dirigerez la recherche sur la conception et la mise en œuvre de méthodes mathématiquement saines pour l'optimisation topologique des matériaux architecturés, en tirant parti de techniques de simulation rapide telles que les méthodes d'éléments finis impropres, la décomposition de domaine, la modélisation à ordre réduit ou l'analyse isogéométrique. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement dynamique et collaboratif, contribuant à la fois au développement théorique et à la mise en œuvre logicielle de ces méthodes. Plus précisément: • Diriger et contribuer à des projets de recherche dans les grands domaines de la simulation numérique et de l'optimisation de la topologie, dans le cadre de la FLASH et d'initiatives connexes • Développer, mettre en œuvre et entretenir un logiciel interne d'optimisation de la simulation et de la topologie • Analyser, interpréter et publier les résultats dans des revues internationales de premier plan • Présenter vos travaux lors de conférences nationales et internationales et construire un solide réseau dans ce domaine • Mentor et co-superviser les doctorants et les étudiants de maîtrise • Contribuer aux activités d'enseignement au sein du groupe • Aider à la préparation de propositions de subventions et de rapports de projets • Vous êtes le candidat idéal si • Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat (ou êtes sur le point d'en terminer un) en mathématiques, en mécanique informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe • Vous avez une solide expérience dans l'optimisation de la topologie, idéalement avec l'expérience des méthodes basées sur la densité (SIM), les approches de niveau, ou les cadres de conception pour la fabrication connexes • Vous avez une expérience de recherche dans les méthodes numériques pour les PDE: les méthodes d'éléments finis, les méthodes immergées/inadaptées, l'homogénéisation, ou l'analyse isogéométrique sont particulièrement pertinentes • Vous êtes compétent en Python ; En tant qu’Adjoint.e EM-PP / Responsable de l’assurance qualité, vous pilotez le système qualité de l’EPFL et assurez la préparation ainsi que le suivi de l’accréditation institutionnelle. descriptionByLocale.it: Missione Con più di 100 apprendisti in formazione in una dozzina di professioni, EPFL è una società di formazione a pieno titolo. Indipendentemente dall'apprendistato scelto all'EPFL, gli apprendisti svolgono la loro formazione professionale in un ambiente straordinario composto da laboratori di ricerca in settori diversi come l'ingegneria, le scienze e l'architettura esatte. Essi beneficiano di tutto il dinamismo e la diversità di un campus universitario che offre loro molte opportunità, vantaggi e opportunità di sviluppo personale. Presso l'École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), avete l'opportunità di intraprendere un entusiasmante apprendistato nel campo della chimica. Incontro con Sébastien, apprendista Laborantin in chimica Principali compiti e responsabilità Il luogo di apprendistato è offerto presso il Laboratorio Ambientale Centrale (CEL) della Facoltà di Ambiente Naturale, Architettonico e Costruito (ENAC). CEL è una piattaforma analitica multidisciplinare attiva nei settori della chimica ambientale, della biologia molecolare e della microbiologia. Con strumenti analitici avanzati, il laboratorio sviluppa e applica metodi per caratterizzare e quantificare una vasta gamma di composti chimici e oligoelementi di grande interesse ambientale. Le attività di ricerca del CEL includono lo studio del destino, il trasporto e l'impatto degli inquinanti in ambienti acquatici e terrestri. Come apprendista in chimica, parteciperai ad una vasta gamma di attività pratiche e analitiche, tra cui: - Preparare campioni per l'analisi (estrazione, digestione, filtrazione) - Imparare a utilizzare strumenti analitici ad alta tecnologia (LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, IC, ICP-OES, ICP-QQQQQ, ecc.) per caratterizzazione e quantificazione di sostanze organiche e inorganiche. - Identificare e caratterizzare molecole utilizzando diversi metodi di spettrometria di massa. - Analisi di condotta su campioni ambientali (acqua, suolo, sedimenti), campioni biologici, nonché su vari materiali dei laboratori EPFL o di altri istituti di ricerca. - Interpretare i risultati analitici per valutare l'accuratezza, la riproducibilità e l'affidabilità delle misurazioni. - partecipare al corretto funzionamento del laboratorio applicando le procedure di qualità e sicurezza esistenti. Profilo L'apprendistato di orientamento Laborantine Chimica è accessibile ai giovani alla fine della scuola obbligatoria (VP, VG2, ginnasio ...), e che mostrano un forte interesse per le scienze e le professioni di laboratorio. Per completare la procedura di postulazione, si prega di aggiungere alla postulazione: - lettera di copertura curriculum vitae - copia dei bollettini scolastici per gli ultimi 3-4 semestri - copie dei certificati, diplomi ottenuti, certificati di tirocinio Cosa fare Diventando un apprendista all'EPFL, trarrete vantaggio da: - un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale - 6 settimane di vacanza indipendentemente dalla tua età - uno stipendio superiore alle proposte del cantone - la possibilità di fare uno stage all'estero di 6 mesi grazie alla borsa di studio Movetia - aiuti per il finanziamento delle vie di trasporto pubblico - l'accesso ai moduli di formazione specifici offerti dall'EPFL agli apprendisti al lavoro sull'autonomia, la responsabilità e il successo degli apprendisti - accesso al centro sportivo e alle varie attività offerte Contatto D

Mission With more than 100 apprentices in training in a dozen professions, EPFL is a fully-fledged training company. Regardless of the apprenticeship chosen at EPFL, apprentices carry out their vocational training in an extraordinary environment composed of research laboratories in fields as varied as engineering, the exact sciences and architecture. They benefit from all the dynamism and diversity of a university campus that offers them many opportunities, advantages and opportunities for personal development. At the École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), you have the opportunity to embark on an exciting apprenticeship in the field of chemistry. Meeting with Sébastien, apprentice Laborantin in chemistry Main tasks and responsibilities The apprenticeship place is offered at the Central Environmental Laboratory (CEL) of the Faculty of Natural, Architectural and Built Environment (ENAC). CEL is a multidisciplinary analytical platform active in the fields of environmental chemistry, molecular biology and microbiology. With advanced analytical instruments, the laboratory develops and applies methods to characterize and quantify a wide range of chemical compounds and trace elements of major environmental interest. CEL's research activities include studying the fate, transport and impact of pollutants in aquatic and terrestrial environments. As an apprentice in chemistry, you will participate in a wide range of practical and analytical activities, including: - Prepare samples for analysis (extraction, digestion, filtration) - Learn to use high-tech analytical instruments (LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, IC, ICP-OES, ICP-QQQ, etc.) for characterization and quantification of organic and inorganic substances. - Identify and characterize molecules using different methods of mass spectrometry. - Conduct analyses on environmental samples (water, soil, sediment), biological samples, as well as on various materials from EPFL laboratories or other research institutions. - Interpret analytical results to assess the accuracy, reproducibility and reliability of measurements. - To participate in the proper functioning of the laboratory by applying the existing quality and safety procedures.
• Profile The apprenticeship of Laborantine orientation Chemistry is accessible to young people at the end of compulsory schooling (VP, VG2, gymnasium ...), and which show a strong interest in the sciences and laboratory professions. To complete the postulation procedure, please add to your postulation: - cover letter curriculum vitae - copy of your school bulletins for the last 3-4 semesters - copies of your certificates, diplomas obtained, certificates of internships Cosa offeriamo By becoming an apprentice at EPFL, you will benefit from: - an exceptional working environment - 6 weeks of vacation regardless of your age - a salary higher than the canton's proposals - the possibility to do an internship abroad of 6 months thanks to the Movetia scholarship - aid for the financing of public transport routes - access to the specific training modules offered by EPFL to apprentices to work on the autonomy, accountability and success of apprenticeships - access to the sports centre and the various activities offered Contatto D

Sie profitieren von all der Dynamik und Vielfalt eines Universitätscampus, der ihnen viele Möglichkeiten, Vorteile und Möglichkeiten für die persönliche Entwicklung bietet. An der École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) haben Sie die Möglichkeit, eine spannende Ausbildung im Bereich der Chemie zu beginnen. Treffen mit Sébastien, Lehrling Laborantin in der Chemie Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten Die Lehrstelle wird im Zentralen Umweltlabor (CEL) der Fakultät für Natur, Architektur und Bauwesen (ENAC) angeboten. CEL ist eine multidisziplinäre analytische Plattform, die in den Bereichen Umweltchemie, Molekularbiologie und Mikrobiologie aktiv ist. Mit fortschrittlichen analytischen Instrumenten entwickelt und wendet das Labor Methoden an, um eine breite Palette von chemischen Verbindungen und Spurenelementen von großem Umweltinteresse zu charakterisieren und zu quantifizieren. Die Forschungsaktivitäten von CEL umfassen die Untersuchung des Schicksals, des Transports und der Auswirkungen von Schadstoffen in aquatischen und terrestrischen Umgebungen. Als Lehrling in der Chemie werden Sie an einer Vielzahl von praktischen und analytischen Aktivitäten teilnehmen, darunter: - Proben zur Analyse vorbereiten (Extraktion, Verdauung, Filtration) - Lernen Sie hochtechnologische Analyseinstrumente (LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, IC, ICP-OES, ICP-QQ, etc.) zur Charakterisierung und Quantifizierung organischer und anorganischer Substanzen verwenden. - Identifizieren und charakterisieren Moleküle mit verschiedenen Methoden der Massenspektrometrie. - Verhaltensanalysen zu Umweltproben (Wasser, Boden, Sediment), biologischen Proben sowie zu verschiedenen Materialien aus EPFL Laboren oder anderen Forschungseinrichtungen. - Interpret analytische Ergebnisse zur Beurteilung der Genauigkeit, Reproduzierbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit von Messungen. - Teilnahme am ordnungsgemäßen Funktionieren des Labors durch Anwendung der bestehenden Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsverfahren. Missione Stiamo cercando un ricercatore postdoctoral altamente motivato per sviluppare le strutture di decodifica neurale di prossima generazione per i dati multimodali del motore e neurali in pazienti con disturbi del movimento. Il progetto si concentra sulla leva di approcci di apprendimento automatico all'avanguardia per prevedere e quantificare i cambiamenti nella funzione motoria e cognitiva, integrando l'elettrofisiologia (ad esempio, LFP, EEG) con il rilevamento indossabile per il monitoraggio in tempo reale e senza ostacoli. Il candidato di successo contribuirà sia all'innovazione metodologica che alla traduzione clinica, lavorando a stretto contatto con pazienti, medici e un team di ricerca multidisciplinare. Chi siamo Il laboratorio SPARK per la neuromodulazione adattiva presso École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) e presso l'Ospedale Universitario di Losanna (CHUV) sta sviluppando terapie di neuromodulazione a ciclo chiuso di prossima generazione per ripristinare la mobilità in pazienti con malattia di Parkinson e disturbi correlati. La nostra ricerca combina ingegneria, neuroscienze e traduzione clinica per affrontare tre obiettivi fondamentali: (i) per caratterizzare esaurientemente i deficit di mobilità nel tempo, le fasi della malattia e i fenotipi del paziente; (ii) per scoprire i meccanismi neurali sottostanti all'andatura e agli squilibri di equilibrio; e (iii) per progettare algoritmi predittivi che attivano e regolano in tempo reale la stimolazione. Embedded all'interno del Neuro-X Institute di EPFL e del NeuroRestore Center di CHUV-UNIL-EPFL, il laboratorio beneficia di un ecosistema di traduzione unico che spazia dalla neurochirurgia (Prof. J. Bloch, Prof. J. Squair), neurologia (Dr. J. Bally), neuroscienze (Prof. G. Courtine, Prof. M. Anderson), e neuroengine Loering (Prof.). Questo ambiente favorisce strette partnership con aziende MedTech come Medtronic e ONWARD Medical per accelerare la traduzione clinica. Negli ultimi dieci anni, il nostro team ha stabilito una piattaforma sperimentale unica che combina la cinematica integrale ad alta risoluzione, le registrazioni delle attività muscolari e i segnali neurali su larga scala (registrazioni subcorticali e corticali). Questo approccio integrato consente lo sviluppo di terapie personalizzate e indipendenti dalle attività attraverso le condizioni neurologiche, tra cui la malattia di Parkinson, lesione del midollo spinale e ictus. EPFL fornisce un ambiente di livello mondiale in ingegneria, calcolo e neuroscienze, consentendo lo sviluppo di algoritmi avanzati e sistemi in tempo reale per la distribuzione del mondo reale. Mission We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to develop next-generation neural decoding frameworks for multimodal motor and neural data in patients with movement disorders. The project focuses on leveraging state-of-the-art machine learning approaches to predict and quantify changes in motor and cognitive function, while integrating electrophysiology (e.g., LFP, EEG) with wearable sensing for real-world, unconstrained monitoring. The successful candidate will contribute to both methodological innovation and clinical translation, working closely with patients, clinicians, and a multidisciplinary research team. Who we are The SPARK laboratory for Adaptive Neuromodulation at École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) and at the University Hospital Lausanne (CHUV) is developing next-generation closed loop neuromodulation therapies to restore mobility in patients with Parkinson’s disease and related disorders. Our research combines engineering, neuroscience, and clinical translation to address three core objectives: (i) to comprehensively characterize mobility deficits across time, disease stages, and patient phenotypes; (ii) to uncover the neural mechanisms underlying gait and balance impairments; and (iii) to design predictive algorithms that adaptively trigger and regulate stimulation in real time. Embedded within the Neuro-X Institute at EPFL and the NeuroRestore Center at CHUV–UNIL-EPFL, the lab benefits from a uniquely translational ecosystem spanning neurosurgery (Prof. J. Bloch, Prof. J. Squair), neurology (Dr. J. Bally), neuroscience (Prof. G. Courtine, Prof. M. Anderson), and neuroengineering (Prof. H. Lorach). This environment fosters close partnerships with MedTech companies such as Medtronic and ONWARD Medical to accelerate clinical translation. Over the past decade, our team has established a unique experimental platform combining high-resolution whole-body kinematics, muscle activity recordings, and large-scale neural signals (subcortical and cortical recordings). This integrated approach enables the development of personalized, activity-dependent therapies across neurological conditions, including Parkinson’s disease, spinal cord injury, and stroke. EPFL provides a world-class environment in engineering, computation and neuroscience, enabling the develop-ment of advanced algorithms and real-time systems for real-world deployment. These capabilities are tightly integrated with CHUV’s clinical infrastructure, one of Switzerland’s five university hospitals and the only center in the French-speaking region performing deep brain stimulation for movement disorders. The position will be based at Campus Biotech in Geneva and will involve regular interactions with EPFL and CHUV teams in Lausanne. Main duties and responsibilities
• Develop and implement state-of-the-art neural decoding frameworks for multimodal motor and neural datasets
• Identify and validate clinically relevant neural biomarkers across therapeutic conditions.
• Contribute to the development of closed-loop and adaptive neuromodulation strategies, and to the deployment of next-generation neuromonitoring platforms integrating high-resolution kinematics, neurobiomechanical modeling, and neural decoding for closed-loop therapy delivery.
• Integrate neural decoding with wearable sensing systems for real-world, unconstrained monitoring
• Design and conduct experiments in close collaboration with clinicians and patients.
• Supervise MSc/PhD students and contribute to the coordination of ongoing projects within the team.
• Contribute to high-impact publications and to grant writing, scientific dissemination, and the development of collaborations across EPFL, CHUV, and partner institutions.
• Help coordinate laboratory activities and support the structuring of a collaborative and high-performing research environment. Profile
• You hold a PhD in neurotechnology, neural engineering, computational neuroscience, brain–com

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Il Laboratorio Fotonico Ibrido di EPFL è alla ricerca di candidati di talento e motivati a lavorare nel campo dei Fotonici Integrati per la metrologia di precisione di segnali elettronici di alta qualità a frequenze elevate oltre 100 GHz. Questa è una parte di un consorzio più grande all'interno del Centro Nazionale di Competenza in Ricerca ( Precisione NCCR) .

Gli oscillatori di Millimeterwave e di terahertz sono componenti critici nell'accesso e nella preparazione negli stati di Rydberg (https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.82.1831 ), nella guida e nella lettura di qubit di superconduzione ad alta temperatura (https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.11170 Tuttavia, il progresso in questo settore è attualmente ostacolato dalla difficoltà di raggiungere fonte efficace e rivelatori in questa gamma di frequenze impegnativa che rimane difficile da accedere utilizzando l'elettronica convenzionale. Il nostro laboratorio ha fatto progressi significativi nella concettualizzazione, attuazione e dimostrazione di chip miniaturizzati per generare e rilevare radiazioni terahertz per mezzo di fotonici. Basandosi su queste dimostrazioni, vogliamo ricorrere a fotonici e superconduttori per realizzare rivelatori di onde millimetri coerenti a livello singolo.

Potrai sfruttare la piattaforma di fotonici niobate a basso contenuto di film, che possiamo fabbricare in-house, in EPFL, per realizzare oscillatori e mixer locali a base di chip-scale, fotonics terahertz, i due blocchi di costruzione essenziali necessari per l'esecuzione della metrologia eterodinica ad alta precisione. Ci proponiamo di ottenere un'amplificazione significativa in questo schema di eterodina, massimizzando l'intensità degli oscillatori locali terahertz. descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

The Hybrid Photonics Laboratory at EPFL is seeking for talented and motivated candidates to work in the field of Integrated Photonics for precision metrology of high-quality electronic signals at elevated frequencies beyond 100 GHz. This is a part of a larger consortium within the National Center for Competence in Research ( NCCR Precision ) .

Millimeterwave and terahertz oscillators are critical components in accessing and preparing in Rydberg states ( https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.82.1831 ) , driving and read-out of high-temperature superconducting qubits ( https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.11170 ) , or for studying low-energy excitations, including phonons, plasmons, or superconducting phenomena. Yet, progress in this area is currently hindered by the difficulty to achieve effective source and detectors in this challenging frequency range which remains difficult to access using conventional electronics. Our lab has been making significant progress in conceptualizing, implementing and demonstrating miniaturized chips to generate and detect terahertz radiation by means of photonics. Building upon these demonstrations, we want to resort to photonics and superconductors to realize single-photon level coherent millimeterwave detectors.

You will exploit the low-loss thin film lithium niobate photonics platform, which we can fabricate in-house, at EPFL, to realize chip-scale, photonics-based terahertz local oscillators and mixers, the two essential building blocks required for performing high-precision heterodyne metrology. We aim to achieve a significant amplification in this heterodyne scheme, by maximizing the intensity of the terahertz local oscillators. In parallel, you will improve the noise performance both on the optics side and on the terahertz side through injection locking and using signals disseminated within the SI-traceble frequency dissemination network planned within this NCCR. You will fabricate these hybrid devices in-house at EPFL cleanroom using newly developed fabrication protocols available in the group.

As a successful candidate of a dynamic team, you will shape the future of photonics-based millimeterwave-optical technology in our young and dynamic lab. You will develop first-of-their kind hybrid platforms that enable complex high-frequency operations directly inside miniaturized photonic chips.

You will kick off diverse aspects of the experimental effort: technical (setting up an optical measurement setup design, including design of high-frequency electronics and custom-tailored mechanical components) and conceptual (develop the theory of millimeterwave/terahertz generation and detection inside photonic chips). In the lab, you will learn about integrated and free-space quantum optical technologies and engineering, and nonlinear optics. You will contribute to the automatisation of measurement routines, comprehensive characterisation of fabricated samples and to bridging the area of microwave/terahertz-optical science and technology with the most modern integrated photonic techniques.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Develop miniaturised millimeterwave/terahertz oscillator and mixers and apply them to photonic circuits, together with their driving software/hardware, automatize measurement procedures.

• Simulate optical and mmW/THz properties using simulations software such as COMSOL or CST.

• Characterize samples in the lab.

• Model experimental data from first principles using Matlab/Python codes.

• Write scientific publications, file patents, disseminate work at national and international conferences.

• Maintain collaborations and deliver periodic reports that describe your progress within the project.

Profile

• M.Sc. in Physics or related fields, strong interest in high-frequency electronics and integrated photonics, nonlinear optics, high-frequency electronics, metrology and/or electro-optic transduction are mandatory.

• Knowledgeable in Python, Matlab,

Mission

Das Hybrid Photonics Laboratory der EPFL sucht nach talentierten und motivierten Kandidaten, auf dem Gebiet der integrierten Photonik für die Präzisionsmesstechnik hochwertiger elektronischer Signale bei erhöhten Frequenzen über 100 GHz zu arbeiten. Dies ist Teil eines größeren Konsortiums im National Center for Competence in Research (NCCR Precision ) .

Millimeterwellen- und Terahertz-Oszillatoren sind wichtige Komponenten beim Zugriff und bei der Vorbereitung in Rydberg-Staaten (https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.82.1831 ), beim Fahren und Auslesen von Hochtemperatur-Supraleitenden Qubits (https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.11170 ), Der Fortschritt in diesem Bereich wird jedoch derzeit durch die Schwierigkeit behindert, effektive Quellen und Detektoren in diesem herausfordernden Frequenzbereich zu erreichen, der mit konventioneller Elektronik schwer zugänglich bleibt. Unser Labor hat erhebliche Fortschritte bei der Konzeption, Umsetzung und Demonstration miniaturisierter Chips erzielt, um Terahertz-Strahlung mittels Photonik zu erzeugen und zu erkennen. Aufbauend auf diesen Demonstrationen wollen wir auf Photonik und Supraleiter zurückgreifen, um kohärente Millimeterwellendetektoren auf ein Photonenniveau zu realisieren.

Sie werden die verlustarme Dünnschicht-Lithiumniobat-Photonik-Plattform nutzen, die wir hauseigene, in EPFL produzieren können, um Chip-Skala, photonics-basierte Terahertz lokale Oszillatoren und Mischer zu realisieren, die zwei wesentlichen Bausteine, die für die Durchführung hochpräziser Heterodyn-Messtechnik erforderlich sind. Wir wollen eine signifikante Verstärkung in diesem Heterodynsystem erreichen, indem wir die Intensität der lokalen Oszillatoren von Terahertz maximieren. Parallel dazu verbessern Sie die Rauschleistung sowohl auf der Optik- als auch auf der Terahertz-Seite durch Einspritzverriegelung und mit Signalen, die innerhalb des in diesem NCCR geplanten SI-Raceble-Frequenzverbreitungsnetzes verbreitet werden. Sie werden diese Hybrid-Geräte in-house bei EPFL Reinraum mit neu entwickelten Fertigungsprotokollen in der Gruppe erstellen.

Als erfolgreicher Kandidat eines dynamischen Teams werden Sie in unserem jungen und dynamischen Labor die Zukunft der fotonikbasierten Millimeter-Optik-Technologie prägen. Sie entwickeln Hybrid-Plattformen der ersten Art, die komplexe Hochfrequenzoperationen direkt innerhalb miniaturisierter Photonikchips ermöglichen.

Sie werden verschiedene Aspekte des experimentellen Aufwands abstoßen: technisches (Einrichten eines optischen Mess-Setup-Designs, einschließlich Design von Hochfrequenz-Elektronik und maßgeschneiderten mechanischen Komponenten) und konzeptionelles (Entwickeln Sie die Theorie der Millimeterwellen-/Terahertz-Generation und Detektion innerhalb von Photonenchips). Im Labor erfahren Sie über integrierte und freiraum-Quantenoptiken und Engineering und nichtlineare Optik. Sie werden zur Automatisierung von Messabläufen, zur umfassenden Charakterisierung von gefertigten Proben und zur Überbrückung des Bereichs Mikrowelle/Terahertz-optische Wissenschaft und Technologie mit den modernsten integrierten photonischen Techniken beitragen.

Mission

Le Laboratoire de photonique hybride de l'EPFL recherche des candidats talentueux et motivés pour travailler dans le domaine de la photonique intégrée pour la métrologie de précision de signaux électroniques de haute qualité à des fréquences élevées au-delà de 100 GHz. Ceci fait partie d'un consortium plus vaste au sein du Centre national de compétence en recherche ( NCCR Precision ) .

Les oscillateurs Millimeterwave et térahertz sont des composants essentiels pour accéder aux états de Rydberg et les préparer ( https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.82.1831), pour conduire et lire les qubits supraconducteurs à haute température ( https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.11170 ) ou pour étudier les excitations à basse énergie, y compris les phonons, les plasmons ou les phénomènes supraconducteurs. Pourtant, les progrès dans ce domaine sont actuellement entravés par la difficulté d'obtenir des sources et des détecteurs efficaces dans cette plage de fréquences difficile, qui reste difficile d'accès à l'électronique classique. Notre laboratoire a réalisé des progrès importants dans la conceptualisation, la mise en œuvre et la démonstration de puces miniaturisées pour générer et détecter des radiations de térahertz au moyen de photonique. S'appuyant sur ces démonstrations, nous voulons recourir à la photonique et aux supraconducteurs pour réaliser des détecteurs à ondes millimétriques cohérents à un seul photon.

Vous exploiterez la plate-forme de photonique au lithium niobate à faible perte, que nous pouvons fabriquer en interne, à l'EPFL, pour réaliser des oscillateurs et des mélangeurs locaux au térahertz à l'échelle des puces, à base de photonique, les deux éléments de construction essentiels nécessaires pour effectuer une métrologie hétérodyne de haute précision. Nous visons à obtenir une amplification significative dans ce schéma hétérodyne, en maximisant l'intensité des oscillateurs térahertz locaux. En parallèle, vous améliorerez les performances sonores tant du côté optique que du côté térahertz grâce au verrouillage par injection et à l'utilisation de signaux diffusés dans le réseau de diffusion de fréquences SI-traçable prévu dans ce NCCR. Vous fabriquerez ces appareils hybrides en interne au salon propre de l'EPFL en utilisant les protocoles de fabrication nouvellement développés disponibles dans le groupe.

En tant que candidat retenu d'une équipe dynamique, vous façonnerez l'avenir de la technologie photonique à ondes millimétriques optiques dans notre jeune laboratoire dynamique. Vous développerez des plates-formes hybrides qui permettent des opérations complexes à haute fréquence directement à l'intérieur de puces photoniques miniaturisées.

Vous lancerez divers aspects de l'effort expérimental: technique (mise en place d'une configuration de mesure optique, y compris la conception d'électroniques haute fréquence et de composants mécaniques sur mesure) et conceptuelle (développement de la théorie de la génération d'ondes millimétriques/terahertz et détection à l'intérieur de puces photoniques). Au laboratoire, vous apprendrez sur les technologies et l'ingénierie quantiques intégrées et libres, ainsi que sur l'optique non linéaire. Vous contribuerez à l'automatisation des routines de mesure, à la caractérisation complète des échantillons fabriqués et à l'intégration des techniques photoniques intégrées les plus modernes dans le domaine de la science et de la technologie micro-ondes/terahertz.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités

• Mettre au point des oscillateurs et des mélangeurs miniaturisés à ondes millimétriques/terahertz et les appliquer aux circuits photoniques, ainsi qu'à leur logiciel de conduite/matériel, automatiser les procédures de mesure.

• Simuler les propriétés optiques et mmW/THz en utilisant des logiciels de simulation tels que COMSOL ou CST.

• Caractériser les échantillons dans le laboratoire.

• Modéliser les données expérimentales des premiers principes en utilisant les codes Matlab/Python.

• Ecrire des publications scientifiques, déposer des brevets, diffuser des travaux lors de conférences nationales et internationales.

• Maintenir la collaboration et produire des rapports périodiques décrivant les progrès réalisés dans le cadre du projet.

Profil

descriptionByLocale.it: Profile The Structural Xploration Lab is seeking a new research collaborator with practical experience in structural engineering related to concrete buildings. Candidates must hold a master's degree in civil engineering and have at least three years of professional experience. A PhD is not required, but an interest in performing structural design in a research setting is expected. The employment rate will range between 40% and 100% and may evolve over time, depending on the candidate’s availability. This is a one-year contract, renewable. Earliest start date is April 15th or as soon as possible. Missions Depending on the employment rate, the candidate will work on various projects, all in collaboration with SXL researchers and foreign building experts and professionals. The main project consists of the structural assessment of concrete slabs in damaged buildings in the Kiev oblast and the engineering required for their deconstruction with a view to their reuse in new housing in Ukraine. This project is supported by EPFL Tech4Dev and carried out in collaboration with a humanitarian architecture firm and local contractors in the Kiev oblast. In addition to this project and depending on the employment rate, the candidate may also contribute to an EU Horizon project whose tasks include assessing the load-bearing capacity of a selection of typical low-rise residential buildings in Europe and structurally optimising a new façade system, in collaboration with foreign industrial and research partners. The candidate may also contribute to various teaching activities and the supervision of civil engineering students at bachelor's and master's level. About us The Structural Xploration Lab is a group of doctoral and postdoctoral researchers in architecture and civil engineering. It is known for its development of tools, design methods, large-scale analyses and built prototypes aimed at enabling the Architecture, Engineering and Construction (AEC) sector to adopt more circular load-bearing systems. SXL also contributes to teaching building technologies and circular practices to undergraduate, master's students and professionals in architecture and civil engineering. As a unit of EPFL's ENAC faculty and located in the Smart Living Lab in Fribourg (CH), SXL benefits from state-of-the-art research infrastructure and offers an inclusive, international and stimulating work environment. Application Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply your CV and a brief statement of interests. For any further information, please contact teresa.messina@epfl.ch .

descriptionByLocale.fr: Profil Le structural Xploration Lab cherche un nouveau collaborateur de recherche ayant une expérience pratique en ingénierie structurelle liée aux bâtiments en béton. Les candidats doivent détenir une maîtrise en génie civil et avoir au moins trois ans d'expérience professionnelle. Un doctorat n'est pas requis, mais on s'attend à ce qu'on s'intéresse à la conception structurelle dans un contexte de recherche. Le taux d'emploi varie entre 40 % et 100 % et peut évoluer au fil du temps, selon la disponibilité du candidat. C'est un contrat d'un an, renouvelable. La date de début la plus tôt est le 15 avril ou le plus tôt possible. Missions Selon le taux d'emploi, le candidat travaillera sur divers projets, le tout en collaboration avec des chercheurs SXL et des experts et professionnels du bâtiment étrangers. Le projet principal consiste en l'évaluation structurelle des dalles de béton dans les bâtiments endommagés de l'oblast de Kiev et en l'ingénierie nécessaire à leur déconstruction en vue de leur réutilisation dans de nouveaux logements en Ukraine. Ce projet est soutenu par EPFL Tech4Dev et réalisé en collaboration avec une firme d'architecture humanitaire et des entrepreneurs locaux dans l'oblast de Kiev. En plus de ce projet et en fonction du taux d'emploi, le candidat peut également contribuer à un projet Horizon de l'UE dont les tâches comprennent l'évaluation de la capacité portante d'une sélection de bâtiments résidentiels typiques à faible hauteur en Europe et l'optimisation structurelle d'un nouveau système de façade, en collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et de recherche étrangers. Le candidat peut également contribuer à diverses activités d'enseignement et à la supervision des étudiants en génie civil au niveau du baccalauréat et de la maîtrise. Sur nous Le Laboratoire de Xpluration structurale est un groupe de chercheurs doctorals et postdoctoraux en architecture et en génie civil. Il est connu pour son développement d'outils, de méthodes de conception, d'analyses à grande échelle et de prototypes construits visant à permettre au secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction (AEC) d'adopter des systèmes de charge plus circulaires. SXL contribue également à l'enseignement des technologies de construction et des pratiques circulaires aux étudiants de premier cycle, aux étudiants de maîtrise et aux professionnels en architecture et en génie civil. En tant qu'unité de la faculté ENAC de l'EPFL et située dans le Smart Living Lab de Fribourg (CH), SXL bénéficie d'une infrastructure de recherche de pointe et offre un environnement de travail inclusif, international et stimulant.
